title: The transcendental-parameter conjecture for the convexity region
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be the set of complex parameters $\lambda$ for which $R_\lambda$ is convex. **The transcendental-parameter conjecture.** Every transcendental complex number belongs to $\mathcal C$:

$$
\mathcal C\text{ contains all transcendental numbers.}
$$

The authors note that the parameters known not to lie in $\mathcal C$ are algebraic integers, but provide no proof of the conjecture.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.2889

Status: **open** according to the source (as of December 2012). “There are a number of open questions about $R_\lambda$ when $\lambda$ belongs to a discrete subring of $D$.”
source_name: Stephen Fenner, Frederic Green and Steven Homer, “Fixed-Parameter Extrapolation and Aperiodic Order”, arXiv:1212.2889 (2020).
